title: Michael
creator: CrossFit
description: Three rounds of an 800 m run, 50 back extensions and 50 sit-ups, for time. Honours Navy Lt. Michael McGreevy, 30, killed in Afghanistan in June 2005 in the same operation as Michael Murphy. Simple and long on the trunk; GHD or floor back extensions both work.
